## Description
Please include a summary of the change and which issue is fixed or requirement addressed.

## Type of change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Stored Procedure / Trigger / Database Optimization
- [ ] Documentation / Viva preparation update

## Checklist
- [ ] My code follows the style guidelines of this project
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my own code
- [ ] I have commented my code, particularly in hard-to-understand SQL blocks
- [ ] I have verified that concurrency tests pass with 0 double bookings
- [ ] My changes generate no new warnings
